message:
Last week, we had a surprise blackout that lasted a few hours. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and set up a little cozy corner with a couple of lanterns. Just as I was settling in, my family group chat lit up with messages! My daughter sent a meme about ‘surviving the apocalypse’ while my son shared a pic of his homemade snack—peanut butter and crackers, of course! 

It turned into a fun little moment, reminding me that even in the dark, we can find ways to connect and laugh. 

So, if you ever find yourself in the dark, don’t forget to check in with your loved ones! What’s your favorite way to stay connected during a power outage?
